name: LoginAura
author: Amel-Nokoe

sections.description:
LoginAura turns the default WordPress login page into a beautiful, branded experience that matches your site in minutes, with zero code.

Whether you’re an agency building client sites, a SaaS founder, or a blogger who wants a consistent login experience LoginAura helps you customize it easily.

Features

Themes

  • Dark — Modern dark UI with accent glow
  • Light — Clean professional white design
  • Minimal — Simple and distraction-free
  • Custom — Full control over colors

Branding

  • Upload custom logo
  • Adjust logo size and position
  • Custom login title and tab text

Background Options

  • Solid colors
  • Gradients
  • Background images
  • Subtle overlay effects

Login Form

  • Customize input fields
  • Button styling
  • Show/hide login elements (remember me, links, etc.)
  • Custom footer text

Redirects

  • Login redirect (global or per role)
  • Logout redirect URL

Customization

  • Live preview via WordPress Customizer
  • Custom CSS support

Pro Version

Unlock advanced features:

  • Premium themes and animations
  • Background video support
  • Two-column login layouts
  • Analytics dashboard
  • Security enhancements (rate limiting, IP blocklist)
  • White-label mode
  • WooCommerce login styling
  • Advanced role controls
  • Import/Export settings

Learn more at: https://afficashpay.com/loginaura

Compatibility

  • WooCommerce
  • BuddyPress
  • bbPress
  • WordPress multisite
  • All standard themes
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin to /wp-content/plugins/loginaura
  2. Activate it
  3. Go to Settings → LoginAura
  4. Customize your login page
sections.faq:
Does it affect site speed?

No, it only loads on wp-login.php.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, it supports default WooCommerce login.

Will settings be lost?

No, settings are preserved on deactivation.
